snippet.title: The same gravel ride in six kinds of day – Col de Berg, the indoor gravel game
snippet.description:
One stretch of gravel along the Ammer in Upper Bavaria, ridden six times: misty morning, midday sun, an overcast sky, rain, autumn and an evening sun. The camera moves the same way every time and the rider pedals the same stroke, so the cut can change the light, the weather and the season without the shot ever breaking.

Everything you see is Col de Berg itself, rendered at 4K on the game's highest settings. The slow-motion sprint was filmed again at 120 frames a second rather than stretched.

Col de Berg is an indoor riding game built for gravel. The roads are real: the route, the ground under it and the surfaces come from survey and open data, so a climb is the climb you'd ride outside and the gravel starts where it really starts. You choose the hour, the weather and the month. The rider on screen moves with your effort: on the hoods, down on the drops, out of the saddle when you sprint. It rides through the free Indoor Bike app, which runs your smart trainer from a phone or tablet.

▶ Beta opening soon
Leave your email at https://coldeberg.bike/#beta and we'll write once, when the beta is ready to download. Free during the beta.

▶ Links
Col de Berg: https://coldeberg.bike
Indoor Bike, the free trainer app it rides through: https://indoorbike.app

This is a game in development: what you see is the current build, and it keeps changing.
Col de Berg is made by Snapp Technology.
